profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer - Specializing in Ruby on Rails, Web Development & Agile Methodologies
profile.summary:
Hey there! I'm Catalino Rodriguez, currently flexing my coding muscles as a Software Engineer at LoadUp. Oh, and did I mention I served in the US Army? That experience, combined with my tech passion, gives me a unique lens in the software world.

Fresh out of an immersive bootcamp at LEARN Academy, I've got a solid grip on Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL, and a few more tech goodies. From crafting sleek websites to innovative web apps, I'm well versed in different stacks.

At LoadUp, I've:

Closed over 25 tickets, spanning both mobile and browser apps.
Revamped the UI of our driver mobile app, reducing the bounce rate. 
Streamlined our backend processes, reducing server response times. 
At work, I dive into challenges and thrive when collaborating with my team. Thanks to my Army days, I come equipped with discipline, adaptability, and a knack for strategic problem-solving.


Looking for a techie with a twist? Let's chat about how I can bring value to your team. 

LinkedInContact@eliment.org

Cheers!

SKILLS
- Web Development: Skilled in front-end development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; adept with frameworks like React.
- Backend Development: Proficient in Ruby and Ruby on Rails for robust web applications.
- Database Management: Efficient with PostgreSQL for data management.
- Version Control: Skilled in Git for streamlined software development.
- Content Management: Experienced in WordPress customization.
- Problem Solving: Analytical thinker with a knack for effective solutions.
- Team Collaboration: Collaborative mindset, excelling in cross-functional teams.

Tags: Software Engineer Intern, Full Stack Development, Ruby on Rails, Relational Databases, Code Reviews, React, PostgreSQL, Jest, JavaScript, Node.js, Veteran, Discipline, Adaptability, Problem-Solving, Time Management.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Specializing in Ruby on Rails, Web Development & Agile Methodologies
positions.description:
During my internship at LoadUp as a Software Engineer, I had the opportunity to contribute to various improvements across the application suite designed for Customers, Loaders, and Admins:

Application Refinement: Assisted in refining LoadUp's core applications by working closely with teams. I played a role in improving the interaction between loaders and customers for efficient junk removal.

Mobile App Enhancement: Participated in the customization of the Loader and Customer mobile apps, focusing on improving user accessibility and functionality.

Backend Support: Engaged in backend development using Ruby on Rails, contributing to a more stable and efficient application performance.

Frontend Assistance: Collaboratively worked with the team using Tailwind CSS to contribute to the design of responsive and friendly UI/UX interfaces.

Mobile Integration: Took part in the Turbo Native integration process, which facilitated the connection between web applications and native mobile features.

Agile Team Member: Actively engaged in product development within an agile environment, collaborating with various teams for continuous application refinement.

Achievements I Contributed to:

Assisted in resolving numerous issues across both mobile and browser platforms.
Actively participated in coding and collaboratively assisted in launching a new feature for LoadUp’s driver app, enhancing its overall functionality.
Supported the refinement of the driver mobile app's UI.
Contributed to optimizing backend workflows, enhancing server response times.

Throughout my internship, I was committed to learning and contributing positively to ensuring that LoadUp’s platforms efficiently served both loaders and customers.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer at LEARN Academy | JS, React, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL | PeerRecognized MVP
positions.description:
Completed a rigorous 4-month Full Stack Web Developer Bootcamp at LEARN Academy. The program encompassed:

JavaScript Foundations: Mastered core concepts, data structures, and functionalities, including loops, functions, objects, and classes.
React: Progressed from basic to intermediate React, crafting intricate user interfaces and managing state.
Ruby: Delved into backend development with Ruby, understanding its object-oriented nature, methods, blocks, and testing.
Ruby on Rails: Built full-stack applications, exploring MVC architecture, Active Record, and database management with Postgres.
Professional Development: Spent a dedicated week refining tech resumes, enhancing online presence, honing networking techniques, and practicing technical interviews.
Full-Stack Integration: Combined React and Rails to create decoupled applications, understanding API consumption, routing, and CORS.
Authentication: Implemented user authentication in Rails-hosted React components using the Devise gem.
Capstone Project: Collaborated in a team setting, employing agile and scrum methodologies to ideate, plan, and deploy a full-stack web application on Heroku.
Recognized as MVP by peers for outstanding performance and contributions. Ready to leverage this comprehensive training to solve real-world challenges in web development.
positions.insights: Software Development, Team Building and +11 skills

positions.title: Full-Time Caregiver & Wordpress Web Developer / CMS Consultant
positions.description: After retiring from the military in 2015, I dove into full-time care for my special needs son, driven by my dedication to him and my wife, an active-duty soldier. My top priority became ensuring my family's well-being and creating a stable environment for my son. Yet, my passion for digital design and development never waned. I honed my skills in full-stack development at FreeCodeCamp. Simultaneously, I freelanced in graphic design, crafted custom WordPress sites, developed unique themes and plugins for WordPress, and designed bespoke web pages for local businesses. This chapter in my life beautifully marries personal dedication with relentless professional advancement.

positions.title: Combat Medic | Healthcare Specialist | Emergency Medical Procedures, Patient Evacuation
positions.description: During my military service as a medic, I initiated critical life-saving training, equipping over 30 team members for emergency situations. This dedication led to my promotion as Night Time Shift Supervisor, where I oversaw the health of 1,600 personnel, managed records effectively, and fostered professional development. Leading a team of four, I prioritized readiness and team cohesion. I standardized Basic Combat Life Support training for the 1,600-member unit, boosting their emergency proficiency. On a 15-month stint in Iraq, I worked as the primary medic for an infantry unit. Recognizing my expertise post-deployment, I assumed the role of Senior Medic for my Company.
positions.insights: Team Building, Project Management and +7 skills

projects.title: GamerVault  - Rediscover the Magic of Retro Gaming 🎮
projects.description:
Visit https://crod.co/gvs to see the fully functional 💻Demo🎮.

Gamer Vault: Rediscover the Magic of Retro Gaming 🎮

As the tech lead for my capstone project at LEARN Academy, I spearheaded the development of "Gamer Vault" – a nostalgic dive into the world of video games. Whether you're reminiscing about your favorite childhood games or cataloging your gaming journey, Gamer Vault is your go-to platform.

Key Features:

User-Centric Design: Seamless sign-up and login processes powered by JWT and Devise.
Full CRUD Functionality: Effortlessly manage your game collection – add, update, or remove titles as you wish.
External Game Database: Integrated with the RAWG API, offering a vast collection of game titles to explore and add to your vault.
Personalized Touch: Not just a list! Add personal notes to each game, capturing memories associated with them.
Technical Skills Demonstrated:

Full-Stack Development (React, Rails)
Database Design & Management (PostgreSQL)
API Integration & Development (Rawg.io)
User Authentication & Authorization
Front-end Development (CSS, Basic HTML, Javascript, React)
Version Control (Git, GitHub)
Project Management
